title: Big-game nerves
text: It's a big match and you feel really nervous.
tip: Nerves mean you care. Use them.

options.text: Hide out wide so you don't get the ball
options.why: Getting involved early is the best way to settle.

options.text: Breathe slowly and plan an easy first pass
options.why: Focusing on one small thing calms your nerves and gets you into the game.

options.text: Go over everything you have to do in your head
options.why: Knowing your job helps, but thinking about too much can make nerves worse. Pick one simple thing.
